symptom: MOCATRIZ was assigned incompatible activation meanings across threads: canonical-language scan, adaptive execution methodology, and manufacturing model.
root_cause: A memorable canonical token was reused without an account-level activation-signature registry or semantic collision check.
early_signals: MOCATRIZ was explicitly defined first as the canonical-language thread scan trigger
GO MOCATRIZ later became the adaptive execution command
A manufacturing thread separately assigned MOCATRIZ to an end-to-end production model
human_cost: Risk of invoking the wrong protocol and contaminating context across unrelated workstreams.
prevention_rule: Canonical triggers must be unique by activation signature. Before assigning or repurposing one, validate it against the Canonical Token Registry.
automated_detection: Canonical Token Registry rejects duplicate unqualified activation signatures with incompatible semantic domains.
